title: Assessment of Deterrent Effect of Singapore's Anti-money Laundering Laws
what_it_is: Assessment of Deterrent Effect of Singapore's Anti-money Laundering Laws

sections.label: Su Haijin money laundering sentence
sections.summary: Su Haijin was sentenced to 14 months' imprisonment for money laundering and resisting arrest, and $165 million was forfeited.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Although the media often refers to the $3 billion money laundering case, the amounts and charges involved vary across the different cases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: For example, one of the convicted foreigners is Su Haijin.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: He was sentenced to 13 months' and six months' imprisonment respectively.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This sentence was for two counts of money laundering involving about $1.4 million, which were ordered to run concurrently, and a further one month's imprisonment for one count of resisting arrest.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This resulted in a total of 14 months' imprisonment for his offences in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The sentences meted out by the Court for Su and the other Defendants are comparable to sentences imposed in other jurisdictions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Additionally, $165 million, or about 95% of the assets linked to Su and his wife, were forfeited to the state.

sections.label: Inter-Ministerial Committee anti-money laundering review
sections.summary: The Inter-Ministerial Committee set up in end-2023 to review the anti-money laundering regime is still working, with recommendations due in a few months.

sentences.text: As the Member, Dr Tan Wu Meng, would know, the Inter-Ministerial Committee was set up in end-2023 to review our anti-money laundering regime.
The work of the inter-agency committee is still ongoing and recommendations will be made available in a few months' time.
